description: AI Augmentation pattern catalog — maps legacy code patterns to AI/ML replacements with effort, risk, and cross-language AST node metadata.

patterns.label: Nested Conditionals
patterns.description: Deeply nested if/elif/else blocks encoding domain logic across multiple dimensions, often brittle and hard to extend.

language_nodes.python: ast.If with nested ast.If in body or orelse; depth >= 3 detected by recursive visitor
language_nodes.java: IfStatement containing nested IfStatement (depth >= 3); detected via JavaParser IfStmt visitor
language_nodes.csharp: IfStatementSyntax containing nested IfStatementSyntax (depth >= 3); Roslyn SyntaxWalker on IfStatementSyntax
language_nodes.go: *ast.IfStmt with Body containing nested *ast.IfStmt; ast.Inspect depth counter
language_nodes.rust: IfExpr (rust-analyzer) containing nested IfExpr in then_branch; ra_ap_syntax IfExpr visitor
language_nodes.typescript: IfStatement containing nested IfStatement (depth >= 3); TypeScript compiler API forEachChild on IfStatement

patterns.label: Regex-Based User Input Parsing
patterns.description: Hand-crafted regular expressions used to extract structured data from free-form user input — fragile against variations and typos.

language_nodes.python: ast.Call with func.attr in {compile,match,search,findall,fullmatch,sub} on re module, or re.X flag usage on user-derived strings
language_nodes.java: MethodInvocation targeting Pattern.compile, Matcher.matches, Matcher.find, or String.matches with user input argument
language_nodes.csharp: ObjectCreationExpressionSyntax for System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex, or InvocationExpressionSyntax for Regex.Match/IsMatch/Replace
language_nodes.go: CallExpr with regexp package selector: regexp.MustCompile, regexp.Compile, regexp.MatchString
language_nodes.rust: MethodCall or PathExpr for regex::Regex::new, Regex::is_match, Regex::find, Regex::captures
language_nodes.typescript: RegularExpressionLiteral, NewExpression with RegExp callee, or CallExpression of str.match/str.replace with RegExp argument

patterns.label: String Template Rendering
patterns.description: Static string interpolation or Jinja/Handlebars templates that produce repetitive, formulaic output with limited contextual adaptation.

language_nodes.python: ast.JoinedStr (f-string) with > 3 format fields, or ast.Call on jinja2.Template/string.Template/str.format with > 2 keyword args
language_nodes.java: MethodInvocation on String.format or MessageFormat.format with > 2 args; or chained StringBuilder.append calls (>= 5 links)
language_nodes.csharp: InterpolatedStringExpressionSyntax with > 3 interpolation holes, or InvocationExpressionSyntax on string.Format with > 3 args
language_nodes.go: CallExpr on fmt.Sprintf with > 3 format verbs, or CallExpr on text/template.Execute or html/template.Execute
language_nodes.rust: MacroCall of format! with > 3 placeholders, or method chain including handlebars::Handlebars.render or tera::Tera.render
language_nodes.typescript: TemplateLiteral with > 3 TemplateSpan nodes, or CallExpression on handlebars.compile/mustache.render/ejs.render

patterns.label: Scheduled Cron Job
patterns.description: Time-based polling or batch jobs that run on a fixed schedule regardless of whether conditions warrant action.

language_nodes.python: ast.FunctionDef with decorator_list containing names from {cron,scheduled,periodic,every,interval}; or ast.Call on schedule.every/APScheduler.add_job/celery.task.apply_async
language_nodes.java: Annotation with name @Scheduled, @Cron, or @EnableScheduling; or MethodInvocation on ScheduledExecutorService.scheduleAtFixedRate/scheduleWithFixedDelay
language_nodes.csharp: AttributeSyntax with name CronJob/Scheduled/RecurringJob; or ClassDeclarationSyntax implementing IHostedService/BackgroundService with delay loop
language_nodes.go: CallExpr on cron.New() or (*cron.Cron).AddFunc from robfig/cron; or goroutine containing time.Ticker or time.Sleep in a for-loop
language_nodes.rust: MethodCall on tokio_cron_scheduler::JobScheduler or clokwerk::Scheduler; or async fn with loop containing tokio::time::sleep/interval
language_nodes.typescript: CallExpression on cron.schedule/nodeSchedule.scheduleJob/setInterval with numeric or cron-string first arg; or @Cron decorator (NestJS InvocationExpression)

patterns.label: Hardcoded Threshold
patterns.description: Static numeric thresholds (e.g., alert if value > 95) baked into config or code, unable to adapt to seasonal or contextual variance.

language_nodes.python: ast.Compare where comparators[0] is ast.Constant(int|float) and the comparison drives an if/raise/alert call; numeric literal not read from config
language_nodes.java: InfixExpression (==, !=, <, >, <=, >=) with NumberLiteral operand inside an IfStatement that triggers an alert/throw/log
language_nodes.csharp: BinaryExpressionSyntax with LiteralExpressionSyntax (NumericLiteralToken) operand inside an IfStatementSyntax body containing alert/throw/log
language_nodes.go: BinaryExpr with BasicLit token type INT or FLOAT inside an IfStmt whose body calls a log/alert/send function
language_nodes.rust: BinExpr containing Literal (INT_NUMBER or FLOAT_NUMBER) in an IfExpr whose then_branch contains a log/alert/panic call
language_nodes.typescript: BinaryExpression with NumericLiteral operand inside an IfStatement body that calls a log/alert/notify function

patterns.label: DB → Render → Notify Chain
patterns.description: Pipeline that queries a database, formats results into a report, and sends notifications — producing mechanical, context-free summaries.

language_nodes.python: Sequential ast.Call nodes within same function: (1) db call — session.query/cursor.execute/engine.execute, (2) template call — Template.render/str.format/jinja2, (3) notify call — smtplib.sendmail/requests.post/boto3.publish
language_nodes.java: Sequential MethodInvocation in same method: (1) JDBC ResultSet or JPA query, (2) String.format or template engine render, (3) JavaMail Transport.send or HTTP client post
language_nodes.csharp: Sequential InvocationExpressionSyntax in same method body: (1) EF Core/Dapper query, (2) string.Format or Razor render, (3) SmtpClient.Send or HttpClient.PostAsync
language_nodes.go: Sequential CallExpr in same function body: (1) (*sql.DB).Query or ORM Find, (2) fmt.Sprintf or template.Execute, (3) smtp.SendMail or http.Post
language_nodes.rust: Sequential method calls in same fn: (1) sqlx::query/diesel::RunQueryDsl, (2) format!/Tera.render, (3) lettre::SmtpTransport.send or reqwest::Client.post
language_nodes.typescript: Sequential AwaitExpression in same async function: (1) ORM/knex query, (2) template literal or render call, (3) nodemailer.sendMail or axios.post/fetch

patterns.label: Keyword List Search
patterns.description: Exact-match keyword or substring search over documents — misses synonyms, intent, and semantic similarity.

language_nodes.python: ast.Compare with ast.In operator where left is user query and comparators[0] is a list/set literal or variable; or ast.Call on str.find/str.contains/str.__contains__ inside a loop over keyword list
language_nodes.java: MethodInvocation on String.contains, String.indexOf, or List.contains inside a loop or stream filter over a keyword collection
language_nodes.csharp: InvocationExpressionSyntax for string.Contains, string.IndexOf, or Enumerable.Contains inside a loop or LINQ query over keyword enumerable
language_nodes.go: CallExpr on strings.Contains or strings.Index inside a for-range loop over a string slice of keywords
language_nodes.rust: MethodCall str.contains or str.find inside an Iterator.any/filter call over a keyword slice or Vec<&str>
language_nodes.typescript: CallExpression of str.includes, str.indexOf, or Array.prototype.some/find on keyword array inside a search/filter function

patterns.label: Large Rule Table
patterns.description: Hundreds of hand-authored business rules in a spreadsheet or decision table — maintenance-heavy and inconsistent at scale.

language_nodes.python: ast.Dict literal with > 20 key-value pairs used as a dispatch/rule table; or ast.If-elif chain with >= 15 branches in a single function
language_nodes.java: SwitchStatement with >= 15 SwitchCase entries; or Map/HashMap initialization (put chains or Map.of) with >= 20 entries acting as rule dispatch
language_nodes.csharp: SwitchStatementSyntax with >= 15 SwitchSectionSyntax entries, or SwitchExpressionSyntax with >= 15 arms; or Dictionary initialization with >= 20 entries
language_nodes.go: SwitchStmt with >= 15 CaseClause entries; or composite literal map with >= 20 key-value pairs used as rule lookup
language_nodes.rust: MatchExpr with >= 15 MatchArm entries; or large static array/vec of tuples used as rule dispatch table
language_nodes.typescript: SwitchStatement with >= 15 CaseClause entries; or ObjectLiteralExpression with >= 20 PropertyAssignment entries used as rule map
